items.source: Returns the name of the field.
Returns whether the Field is aliased, which means it has a name set different from the target.
items.translation: 返回该字段是否已设置别名，即其名称与目标不同。

items.source: Returns the target of the field. In case no explicit target is available getName() should be returned.
items.translation: 返回字段的对象。如果没有明确的对象，则应返回getName()。

items.source: Returns the target of the field.
true if the field name references a local value such as $$this.
items.translation: 如果字段名引用了本地值（如$$this），则为 true。
